Questions, answered.

How is the shared cursor different?

CursorCue captures your chosen app without its physical cursor, then adds an independent shared cursor. Share the CursorCue Share window instead of the original app.

Does my real mouse still work?

Yes. Freeze and hide affect the shared cursor. Your physical mouse keeps moving and clicking normally in the original app.

Which Windows versions are supported?

Windows 11 is the primary target. Windows 10 version 2004 or newer is best-effort. This version is Windows-only and focuses on selected-window sharing.

Is this ready for everyday calls?

This is a developer preview. Meeting-app compatibility, mixed-DPI behavior, and long-session performance still need validation. The verified Windows build is available below.
